mapper.select: /*getBuyerVocUserSql*/ SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER ,A.KEP_USER_ID ,B.USER_ID ,B.USER_NAME_LOC ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND TYPE='C003' AND CODE = B.POSITION) AS POSITION_NAME ,B.EMAIL ,B.PHONE_NUMBER ,B.MOBILE_PHONE ,B.DEPARTMENT , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'C001' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND COD.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT_NM FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.STATUS ='C' AND B.COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND A.KEP_USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND A.PRIORITY ='Y' ORDER BY A.KEP_USER_ID

/*getBuyerBmUserSql*/ SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER ,A.KEP_USER_ID ,B.USER_ID ,B.USER_NAME_LOC ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND TYPE='C003' AND CODE = B.POSITION) AS POSITION_NAME ,B.EMAIL ,B.PHONE_NUMBER ,B.MOBILE_PHONE ,B.DEPARTMENT , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'C001' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND COD.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT_NM FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.STATUS ='C' AND B.COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND A.KEP_USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND A.MAIN_CLERK ='Y' ORDER BY A.KEP_USER_ID

/*getBuyerStatusCountMainSql*/
SELECT
( SELECT COUNT(A.USER_ID) CNT FROM ICOMCART A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C, CMSCATLG D WHERE B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND B.CMS_CATLG_ID = D.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND D.STD_FLAG(+)='Y' AND A.USE_FLAG = 'C' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','Y','T') AND A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND NVL(A.PRE_GR_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND DECODE(A.BUYER, 'KRHONG0020', A.VERIF_NUM, 'X') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCMPY CM, ICOMCQDT GC WHERE CM.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND CM.USING_CATAL_TYPE IN ('A','C') AND GC.BUYER = CM.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND GC.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = A.BUYER AND GC.CONTRACT_NO = A.CONTRACT_NO AND GC.CONTRACT_SEQ = A.CONTRACT_SEQ AND GC.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND GC.STATUS = 'D' ) ) AS CART_CNT,
(SELECT COUNT(A.PR_SEQ) FROM ICOMPRDT A, ICOMPODT C WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.CHANGE_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE -150,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND C.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND A.RECV_FLAG NOT IN ('RR','GR') AND A.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND A.PR_NO = C.PR_NO(+) AND A.PR_SEQ = C.PR_SEQ(+) AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER(+) AND C.ITEM_QTY <> C.GR_QTY ) AS PR_CNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOGPASSLN A, ICOGDOCU B WHERE A.COMPANY = #{BUYER} AND A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND A.PASS_TP = '0' AND A.COMPANY = B.COMPANY AND A.DOCU_NO = B.DOCU_NO AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND TO_CHAR(B.START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND B.PASS_STATUS = 0 ) AS SEND_CNT, -- 결재상신
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOGDOCU A, ICOGPASSLN B WHERE A.COMPANY IN (SELECT BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'M-APPR' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE2 = #{USER_ID} UNION SELECT #{BUYER} FROM DUAL) AND A.PASS_STATUS = '0' AND A.COMPANY = B.COMPANY AND A.DOCU_NO = B.DOCU_NO AND A.CUR_ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND B.USER_ID IN (SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'M-APPR' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE2 = #{USER_ID} UNION SELECT #{USER_ID} FROM DUAL) AND B.PASS_TP IN ('1','2','3') AND B.PASS_KN IS NULL AND TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ) AS RECV_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOGDOCU A, ICOGPASSLN B WHERE A.COMPANY = #{BUYER} AND A.PASS_STATUS = '0' AND A.COMPANY = B.COMPANY AND A.DOCU_NO = B.DOCU_NO AND A.CUR_ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND B.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND B.PASS_TP IN ('1','2','3') AND B.PASS_KN IS NULL AND A.EXTIF_TP = 'PR' AND TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ) AS PR_RECV_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOGDOCU A, ICOGPASSLN B WHERE A.COMPANY = #{BUYER} AND A.PASS_STATUS = '0' AND A.COMPANY = B.COMPANY AND A.DOCU_NO = B.DOCU_NO AND A.CUR_ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND B.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND B.PASS_TP IN ('1','2','3') AND B.PASS_KN IS NULL AND A.EXTIF_TP = 'PX' AND TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ) AS PX_RECV_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.KEP_USER_ID IS NULL AND A.BTOA_USER_ID = DECODE((SELECT USER_GROUP FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND COM_CODE = #{BUYER}), 'A', A.BTOA_USER_ID, #{USER_ID}) AND A.RECV_FLAG NOT IN ('GD','CM','TS') AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.BTOA_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE -7,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG='N') AS SOUR_CNT,
(SELECT COUNT(A.PR_SEQ) FROM ICOMPRDT A , ICOMTRGW B, ICOMBYIT C, ICOMCQDT E , ICOMPRHD F WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT NVL(CODE2, #{BUYER}) FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND TYPE = 'TGCM' AND CODE1 = #{USER_ID} AND FLAG = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT #{BUYER} FROM DUAL) AND A.ADD_DATE BETWEEN to_char(add_months(sysdate,-3),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.SAVE_FLAG = 'PR' AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'GA' AND A.BUYER = F.BUYER AND A.PR_NO = F.PR_NO AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE(+) AND A.PR_NO = B.KEY_1(+) AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = E.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = E.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.CONTRACT_NO = E.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = E.CONTRACT_SEQ AND E.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND E.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND E.STATUS <> 'D' AND F.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N'
--콘티넨탈(KRCONT0006)일경우, icomcod2에 등록된 cost center별 담당자가 본인인 건만 조회되게 한다. AND CASE WHEN A.BUYER ='KRCONT0006' THEN '1' ELSE A.PURCHASER_DEPT END = CASE WHEN A.BUYER ='KRCONT0006' THEN ( SELECT to_char(count(*)) FROM ICOMCOD2 X WHERE 1=1 AND X.TYPE ='M014' AND NVL(X.FLAG,'Y') = 'Y' AND X.CODE = A.REF_PR_NO AND X.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND X.TEXT4 = #{USER_ID} ) ELSE #{DEPT} END
/* 2022.03.03 발주권 있는 사람만 건수 표기 */ AND CASE WHEN A.BUYER = 'KRCONT0006' THEN 'ALL' ELSE (SELECT SUBSTR(ROLE,1,1) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID}) END IN ('A', 'C', 'P', 'ALL') ) AS PO_CNT,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE A.SO_CA_FLAG = 'SO' AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND TYPE = 'TGCM' AND CODE1 = #{USER_ID} AND FLAG = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT #{BUYER} FROM DUAL) AND A.ATOB_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-30, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION = B.REVISION AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE <> 0 AND A.CONFIRM_DATE IS NULL AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('GA', 'GR') AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.STATUS IN ('C' ,'R') AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'O' AND NVL(A.MSDS_STATUS, 'N') <> 'R' AND A.BTOA_USER_ID = DECODE((SELECT USER_GROUP FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND COM_CODE = #{BUYER}), 'A', A.BTOA_USER_ID, #{USER_ID})
AND TRIM(DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS99999999', '', A.MSDS_NO)) IS NOT NULL AND NVL(A.MSDS_STATUS, 'N') = 'A'
AND NVL(A.MSDS_STATUS, 'N') != 'A'
) AS AGMT_CNT
FROM DUAL

/*getBuyerStatusCountPCOMainSql*/ SELECT
( SELECT COUNT(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM DOOSCART A, ICOMBYIT B WHERE A.USER_ID =#{USER_ID} AND A.USE_FLAG = 'C' AND A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','A') AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) AS CART_CNT,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTR(PR.REF_PR_NO,0,7)) FROM ICOMPRDT PR, ICOMPODT PO WHERE PR.BUYER = PO.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = PO.PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = PO.PR_SEQ AND PR.STATUS <> 'D' AND PO.STATUS <> 'D' AND PR.BUYER =#{BUYER} AND PR.CHANGE_USER_ID =#{USER_ID} AND PR.CHANGE_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ) AS PR_CNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BTOA_USER_ID =#{USER_ID} AND A.BUYER =#{BUYER} AND A.BTOA_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.KEP_USER_ID IS NULL AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('GA','NW') AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R')) AS SOUR_CNT,
( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.po_no||b.po_seq) FROM ICOMPRDT A, ICOMPODT B WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.ADD_USER_ID =#{USER_ID} AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PR_NO = B.PR_NO AND A.PR_SEQ= B.PR_SEQ AND B.STATUS ^= 'D' AND B.ITEM_QTY ^= B.GR_QTY AND B.IV_QTY > B.GR_QTY AND B.DI_QTY >0 ) GR_CNT,
( SELECT COUNT(B.LEGACY_PO_NO||B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) AS COUNT FROM ICOMPOHD A , ICOMPODT B , ICOMPORS C , ICOMPRDT D WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER =#{BUYER} AND B.RD_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') and TO_CHAR(SYSDATE +5 , 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) <> NVL(B.GR_QTY,0) AND NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) <> NVL(B.DI_QTY,0) AND D.CHANGE_USER_ID =#{USER_ID} AND C.ADMIN_FLAG2 != 'Y' AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND B.BUYER = D.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = D.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = D.PR_SEQ AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' ) IV_CNT
FROM DUAL

/*getBuyerBdgtAmt_v2*/ SELECT (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = X.BUYER AND TYPE = 'Z014' AND CODE = X.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS ACCOUNT_TEXT, NVL(Y.PLAN_AMT,0) AS PLAN_AMT, NVL(Y.PLAN_AMT,0) - (NVL(Y.RESULT_AMT,0) + NVL(Y.TEMP_AMT,0)) AS TEMP_AMT FROM( SELECT BUYER, CODE1 AS DEPT, CODE2 AS ACCOUNT_TYPE FROM ICOMCOD3 A , ICOMCOD2 B , ICOMCOD2 C WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND A.BUYER = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.CODE2 = B.CODE AND A.BUYER = C.COMPANY_CODE AND A.CODE1 = C.CODE AND B.TYPE = 'Z014' AND B.FLAG = 'Y' AND C.TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE1 = #{st_dept} AND A.TYPE= 'DTOA' ) X, (SELECT * FROM ICOMBDGT WHERE 1=1 AND BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN FROM_DATE AND TO_DATE ) Y WHERE X.BUYER = Y.BUYER(+) AND X.DEPT = Y.DEPT(+) AND X.ACCOUNT_TYPE = Y.ACCOUNT_TYPE(+) ORDER BY PLAN_AMT DESC

/*getCompanyPass*/
SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') PASS_FLAG FROM ICOGPASS WHERE COMPANY = #{BUYER}
/*getUserGwPass*/ SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') AS GW_PASS_FLAG FROM ICOGPASSLN WHERE PASS_KN IS NULL AND USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND DOCU_NO = #{GW_NO}

/*getShortCutSso*/
SELECT A.COM_CODE, A.USER_ID, A.PASSWORD PASSWORD FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE A.LEGACY_USER_ID = B.LEGACY_USER_ID AND B.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND B.COM_CODE != A.COM_CODE AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: /*CreateSrReq*/ INSERT INTO KEPAVCDT ( VC_NO, REQ_USER_ID, BUYER, RECV_FLAG, REQ_DATE, PH_DATE, CD_USER_ID, CD_DATE, DS_USER_ID, DS_DEPT, DF_DATE, CLAIM_MASTER, PO_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, REQ_REMARK, DS_REMARK_A, DS_REMARK_B, DS_REMARK_C, DF_REMARK, RUB_TYPE, CLAIM_GRADE, IMPUTE_TYPE, IMPUTE_AGENT, DS_CHANGE_DATE, CD_DEPT, CLAIM_TYPE, MRO_AREA_TEXT, REQ_USER_TEL, REQ_USER_NAME, MRO_AREA_CODE, REQ_IMAGE_KEY ) VALUES ( #{VC_NO}, -- 1 VC_NO 접수번호 #{userid}, -- 2 REQ_USER_ID 요청자아이디 #{buyer}, -- 3 BUYER 구매사 #{RECV_FLAG}, -- 4 RECV_FLAG 진행상태 TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), -- 5 REQ_DATE 요청일 TO_DATE(replace(#{st_ph_date},'/',''),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), -- 6 PH_DATE 처리희망일 #{st_cd_user_id}, -- 7 CD_USER_ID 접수자아이디 #{st_cd_date}, -- 8 CD_DATE 접수일 #{st_ds_user_id}, -- 9 DS_USER_ID 처리자아이디 #{st_ds_dept}, -- 10 DS_DEPT 처리부서코드 '', -- 11 DF_DATE 처리완료일 #{st_claim_master}, -- 12 CLAIM_MASTER 대분류클레임 #{st_po_no}, -- 13 PO_NO 발주번호 #{st_buyer_item_no}, -- 14 BUYER_ITEM_NO 품목코드 #{st_req_remark}, -- 15 REQ_REMARK 요청내역 '', -- 16 DS_REMARK_A 진행내역_A '', -- 17 DS_REMARK_B 진행내역_B '', -- 18 DS_REMARK_C 진행내역_C '', -- 19 DF_REMARK 처리내역 '', -- 20 RUB_TYPE 고객평가 '', -- 21 CLAIM_GRADE 클레임등급 '', -- 22 IMPUTE_TYPE 귀책타입 '', -- 23 IMPUTE_AGENT SRM연계공급사 '', -- 24 DS_CHANGE_DATE 처리담당자변경일 #{st_cd_dept}, -- 25 CD_DEPT 접수부서코드 '', -- 26 CLAIM_TYPE 하위클레임 '', -- 27 MRO_AREA 건설사현장 #{tel}, -- 28 REQ_USER_TEL 요청자전화번호 #{userNameLoc}, -- 29 REQ_USER_NAME 요청자명 '', -- 30 MRO_AREA_CODE 건설사현장코드 #{st_image_key} -- 31 REQ_IMAGE_KEY 파일첨부 )
mapper.select: /*getCustomerOrderInfo_v2*/ SELECT COUNT( CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ADD_DATE,0,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') THEN 1 END) AS YEAR_CNT ,SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(ADD_DATE,0,4),TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY'),TRUNC(NVL(TARGET_QTY,0) * NVL(TARGET_PRICE,0)),0)) AS YEAR_AMT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ADD_DATE,0,6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM') THEN 1 END) AS PRE_MONTH_CNT ,SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(ADD_DATE,0,6),TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM'),TRUNC(NVL(TARGET_QTY,0) * NVL(TARGET_PRICE,0)),0)) AS PRE_MONTH_AMT ,COUNT( CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ADD_DATE,0,6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') THEN 1 END) AS CUR_MONTH_CNT ,SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(ADD_DATE,0,6),TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM'),TRUNC(NVL(TARGET_QTY,0) * NVL(TARGET_PRICE,0)),0)) AS CUR_MONTH_AMT FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND STATUS != 'D' AND RECV_FLAG NOT IN ('GR','RR','PR','GD','PD','GC') AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-12), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')

/*getCustomerCenterPop*/
SELECT A.VC_NO, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND USER_ID = A.REQ_USER_ID) AS USER_NAME, A.PO_NO, (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = TRIM(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO)) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC03' AND CODE = A.CLAIM_MASTER) AS CLAIM_MASTER, to_char(A.REQ_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS REQ_DATE, to_char(A.DF_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS DF_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC02' AND CODE = A.RECV_FLAG) AS RECV_FLAG_TEXT, DECODE(A.RUB_TYPE,'A','매우만족','B','만족','C','보통','D','불만','F','매우불만','미평가') AS RUB_TEXT, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.REQ_USER_ID, A.CLAIM_TYPE, A.RECV_FLAG, A.RUB_TYPE, A.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, A.REQ_REMARK, A.DF_REMARK, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE=A.BUYER AND TYPE='C001' AND CODE= #{req_user_dept} ) AS USER_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND CODE = A.CLAIM_TYPE) AS CLAIM_TEXT, A.DS_REMARK_A, A.DS_REMARK_B, A.DS_REMARK_C, to_char(A.PH_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS PH_DATE, A.REQ_IMAGE_KEY, A.FEEDBACK_IMAGE_KEY FROM KEPAVCDT A WHERE A.BUYER =#{buyer} AND A.VC_NO = #{vc_no}
